goal_level_decision_audit.decision: implement M39 local harness before spending the focused POD budget
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Use this harness to gate local correctness and only then run the single focused POD allowed by M38 consensus.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to treat the M38 protocol as data or to run the pod before the local harness proves same input, label outputs, metadata, and cap handling.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Run the focused POD immediately from the fresh M37 helper. That could repeat the old unreviewed-harness failure.
